北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴冷，体感 -3℃，记得多穿暖和！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but chilly, feels like -3°C. Stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 4级 较大，体感 -3℃，注意防风保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is windy with a RealFeel of -3°C. Bundle up against the wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 0℃，注意添衣保暖，别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 0°C. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 15℃。早晚温差大，别忘了添减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny at 15°C. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，气温 15℃。享受阳光，也要注意早晚微凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant at 15°C. Enjoy the sun, but mind the slight evening chill.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 -2℃，风力 3级。出门记得多穿点哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like -2°C with a breeze. Remember to dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光虽好，体感 -1℃。风力 3级，保暖别忽视。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels like -1°C with a breeze. Don't forget to keep warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 97%，体感微凉。多喝热水，注意防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 97% humidity, feels cool. Stay hydrated and mind the dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 2℃，略有湿冷感。记得多添衣哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 2°C with dampness. Remember to layer up!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 -3℃，湿度较高。注意保暖，别感冒了。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels like -3°C with high humidity. Stay warm to avoid colds.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度 81%，体感 4℃。湿冷感较重，多穿点哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 4°C with high humidity. It's damp and chilly, dress warmly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -20℃。户外活动一定要裹严实哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, but feels like -20°C. Bundle up tightly if you go outdoors!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -17℃。保暖是关键，注意防寒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels like -17°C. Staying warm is key, protect yourself from cold.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明风力 5级 较大，体感 9℃。注意防风，别着凉了。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and windy (level 5), feels like 9°C. Watch out for wind, don't catch a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，风力 4级 较大，体感 7℃。出门记得加件外套。

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -4℃，风力 3级。风寒效应强，穿厚点。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -4°C with a breeze. Dress warmly against the wind chill.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -8℃。寒气逼人，一定要多穿暖和。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -8°C. It's very cold, make sure to bundle up warmly!
